description: STATISS is the French health ministry's standard set of regional health and social indicators, and the Mayotte regional health agency publishes its own edition for the department. The 2023 edition, released in April 2025, is a 30-page memento covering demography and epidemiology, health facilities and their equipment, medico-social and social facilities, the health workforce and social protection. Editions for 2012 to 2014 and 2016 to 2023 are free to download as PDFs from the agency's website. The facility, equipment and workforce sections give a compact picture of the island's health service capacity. Caveats: the tables are in PDFs, only the 2023 edition's description was read here, and no licence is stated; national STATISS figures for all French regions are published separately by the ministry's statistics directorate. Coverage is the department of Mayotte. Simulation uses: bed and workforce baselines for health system resilience studies in Mayotte. Related records: the DREES hospital annual statistics (data-drees-sae-hospital-annual-statistics) give facility-level French hospital data that include Mayotte.
